title: Winning a tennis scholarship to 'Bama State
summary: Hawkins, a tennis player and basketball captain, eliminated Talladega and 'Bama State at a relay and was offered a scholarship, after which the college found out about his music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: By the way, I got my scholarship at [Chuckles] 'Bama State playing tennis. I went to a relay at Tuskegee for Tuggle Institute. That was tennis. I went crazy about tennis.

Basketball. I was the captain of my basketball team. All this. If they couldn't find me in the band room, they'd find me on the athletic field. Those two spots they could always find me. They didn't have to look for me.
So, I went out there. I eliminated Talladega in tennis, and 'Bama State in tennis. So, that's how I happened to get my scholarship to go to 'Bama State.
Then, they organized another band there and they found out about my music. They actually didn't know about music. Then, they asked me to leave that alone and go stay in the band.
